name: iterate the arithmetic and geometric means to their common limit
mechanism: replace a pair of numbers by their arithmetic mean and their geometric mean; the two converge quadratically to a common value, and a running correction term built from their squared differences yields the constant

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Gauss–Legendre algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Elementary and special functions: computes the digits of pi

requires: a square root at full precision each round
fails_when: each round needs full-precision arithmetic; no partial digits until the end
